notes: Playback speed in the song menu is a regular slider again: a thin rounded track, a filled portion and a round thumb you can hold, matched with the seek bar in the player.
Albums stop fighting your edits: taking a song out of an album now sticks, and nothing refills the album behind your back on the next start.
An album left with zero songs is deleted for good, and an album you delete stays deleted: the album names still on the songs can no longer rebuild either one.
Leaving the Albums tab now closes every album card except the one the playing song sits in, and it looks the same when you come back.
Play a song from the Albums tab and its own album card opens so the playing row is always visible, alongside the timed lyrics lines.
The music player, the home-screen widget, the lyrics letter wave and everything in the studio dock are untouched by this release.
